data.name: Jabaliya
data.gender_notes: Jabaliya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who lives in or comes from a mountainous area. The name Jabaliya carries the meaning “The Mountainous One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jabaliya usually hope their child will grow to embody the mountainous one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents inner strength and resilience in the face of adversity
data.etymology: Jabaliya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Mountainous One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabaliya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: جبلية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الجبل أو المرأة من جبلية
in_arabic.long_meaning: جبلية هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة جبل، ويعني الجبل أو المرأة التي تعيش في الجبل. وقد وردت كلمة جبل في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَحَمَلْنَآ لَهُ مَطَاعِنَ مِن جِبَالٍ' (الأنبياء: 75)، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة دينية وروحية كبيرة. يعتبر اسم جبلية من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة والصلابة، كما أنه يوحي بالشجاعة والقدرة على تحمل التحديات.

in_urdu.name: جبلية
in_urdu.long_meaning: جبلية ایک علم مؤنث ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے جبل یا پہاڑ سے متعلق، یا وہ شخص جو پہاڑ پر رہتا ہے۔ جبلية نام کا مطلب مضبوطی، قوت، اور پائیداری سے بھی جڑا ہوا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، جبل کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ انبیاء میں: 'وَحَمَلْنَآ لَهُ مَطَاعِنَ مِن جِبَالٍ' (الأنبياء: 75)۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے ایک اہم ثقافتی اور روحانی معنا رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जबलिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: जबलिया एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है पहाड़ी या जेबील (पहाड़) से संबंधित। यह नाम शक्ति, मजबूती और दृढ़ता का प्रतीक है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, पहाड़ (जेबील) का उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है, जैसे सूरह अनबीया में: 'وَحَمَلْنَآ لَهُ مَطَاعِنَ مِن جِبَالٍ' (الأنبياء: 75)। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक महत्वपूर्ण सांस्कृतिक और आध्यात्मिक अर्थ रखता है।

in_pashto.name: جبلۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: جبلۍ د مؤنثو نومونو څخه دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. ددې نوم معنی د جبل څخه یا غرځای دی. دا نوم د پیاوړتیا، قوت او پایدارۍ سره تړلی دی. په اسلامي دود کې، جبل (غر) د قرآن کریم په کښې هم ذکر شوی دی، لکه د انبیاء سورت کې: 'وَحَمَلْنَآ لَهُ مَطَاعِنَ مِن جِبَالٍ' (الأنبياء: 75). دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې یو مهم کلتوري او روحاني معنی لري.

in_english.name: Jabaliya
in_english.meaning: Related to mountain, strong, and resilient
in_english.long_meaning: Jabaliya is a feminine given name derived from Arabic, meaning 'of the mountain' or 'strong and resilient'. The name originates from the Arabic word 'jabal', which means 'mountain'. In the Quran, mountains are mentioned in several contexts, such as in Surah Anbiya: 'And We carried him on a vehicle of planks and nails, And We sailed on a vehicle that could not be submerged, And We saved him and those with him, And We made it a sign.' (21:75-76), highlighting the significance of mountains in Islamic tradition. The name Jabaliya symbolizes strength, endurance, and the ability to overcome challenges. It carries a rich cultural and spiritual heritage across Muslim communities worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jabaliya, meaning 'mountain dweller' or 'mountainous region,' has historical and cultural significance for various Islamic communities. It is particularly associated with Palestinian refugees who were displaced during the 1948 Arab-Israeli War and sought refuge in Gaza's Jabaliya Refugee Camp. The camp, located in a densely populated area between the Mediterranean Sea and the Gaza Strip's mountains, symbolizes resilience and struggle against the harsh conditions of exile and displacement.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, mountains hold deep spiritual significance as they are mentioned multiple times in the Quran. Mountains are cited as refuges for the righteous and signs of Allah's power and creation. The name Jabaliya, meaning 'mountain dweller,' carries this spiritual significance in the literal understanding of the term. On a metaphorical level, it emphasizes the importance of maintaining a strong and unwavering connection to Allah during times of hardship and adversity. Just as the mountainous terrain provides stability and protection to those who live there, Jabaliya serves as a reminder of Allah's steadfastness and the importance of seeking refuge and solace in His divine presence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Mountainous One" symbolizes One who lives in or comes from a mountainous area. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Jabaliya serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the mountainous one.
